query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
billing_type as "Billing type",
admitting_clinician as "Admitting clinician",
to_char(((admission_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Admission date and time",
admission_status as "Admission status",
to_char(((discharge_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Discharge date and time",
facility as "Facility",
departments as "Department history",
department_datetimes as "Department history date and times",
location_groups as "Area history",
location_group_datetimes as "Area history date and times",
locations as "Location history",
location_datetimes as "Location history date and times",
primary_diagnoses as "Primary diagnoses",
primary_diagnoses_codes as "Primary diagnosis codes",
secondary_diagnoses as "Secondary diagnoses",
secondary_diagnoses_codes as "Secondary diagnosis codes"
from "reporting"."ds__admissions"
where
((admission_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) >= 
:fromDate
and ((admission_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) <= 
:toDate
and case when 
:locationGroupId is null then true
else 
:locationGroupId = any(location_group_ids::text [])
end
and case when 
:facilityId is null then true
else facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
and case when 
:departmentId is null then true
else 
:departmentId = any(department_ids::text [])
end
and case when 
:patientBillingTypeId is null then true
else billing_type_id like 
:patientBillingTypeId
end
and case when 
:clinicianId is null then true
else admitting_clinician_id = 
:clinicianId
end
and case when coalesce(
:admissionStatus) is null then true
else admission_status in (
:admissionStatus)
end
order by admission_datetime desc
name: Admissions line list
notes:
This report generates a list of all patients with a hospital admission started within the selected date range. The report includes both active and discharged admissions. Patients are listed in order of most recent admission by admission date and time. The discharge date is displayed if the patient has been discharged, 
otherwise if the encounter is active this column will appear blank. 

The below information is included for each hospital admission:
- List of all assigned departments and the date and time a patient was assigned to each department.
- List of all assigned areas and the date and time a patient was assigned to each area.
- List of all assigned locations and the date and time a patient was assigned to each location.
- List of all primary and secondary diagnoses (including code) with a certainty of 'Confirmed', 'Suspected', or 'Emergency'. Diagnoses with a certainty of 'Disproven' or 'Recorded in error' are excluded.
